summary: Bulk changes finish faster, and pages make full use of your screen.

new.title: Bulk changes apply in one go
new.text: Adopting many Conditional Access policies at once is now applied in one engine check, instead of one per check.

new.title: Status bar says what really happens
new.text: The bar at the top shows when changes are picked up and how many are applied or waiting. A second click no longer sends a change twice.

new.title: Pages use the full window width
new.text: Text, settings, tables and search use the full width of your screen, on laptops and desktops alike.
